evidence: Running ./repro.py in a notebook-style kernel context triggers a ValueError on the second embed call. The exception originates in marimo/_runtime/app/kernel_runner.py:119, where are_outputs_cached() does `defs == self._previously_seen_defs`; comparing numpy arrays with different shapes produces `ValueError: The truth value of an array with more than one element is ambiguous`.
steps: Create a notebook-style runtime context with tests.conftest.MockedKernel.
Call await app.embed(defs={'arr': np.ones(1)}) once to seed the cache.
Call await app.embed(defs={'arr': np.zeros(2)}) and observe the ValueError.
